WITH platelet_history AS (
    SELECT l.ID, COUNT(*) AS lab_rows,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN l.PLT > 100 AND l.PLT < 400 THEN 1 END) AS normal_rows
    FROM main.Laboratory AS l
    GROUP BY l.ID
)
SELECT p.Diagnosis, COUNT(*) AS patient_count,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN h.normal_rows > 0 THEN 1 END) AS patients_with_normal,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN h.lab_rows IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS patients_without_labs
FROM main.Patient AS p
LEFT JOIN platelet_history AS h ON h.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis LIKE '%RA%SJS%' OR p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SJS%RA%'
GROUP BY p.Diagnosis
ORDER BY p.Diagnosis

WITH RECURSIVE diagnosis_entries (ID, remaining, disease) AS (
    SELECT p.ID,
           CASE
               WHEN trim(p.Diagnosis) = 'SJS  RA' THEN 'SJS,RA'
               ELSE replace(p.Diagnosis, char(29), ',')
           END || ',',
           NULL
    FROM main.Patient AS p
    WHERE instr(p.Diagnosis, 'RA') > 0
      AND instr(p.Diagnosis, 'SJS') > 0

    UNION ALL

    SELECT e.ID,
           substr(e.remaining, instr(e.remaining, ',') + 1),
           trim(substr(e.remaining, 1, instr(e.remaining, ',') - 1),
                char(9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 32))
    FROM diagnosis_entries AS e
    WHERE e.remaining <> ''
),
overlap_patients AS (
    SELECT e.ID
    FROM diagnosis_entries AS e
    WHERE e.disease <> ''
      AND e.disease NOT GLOB '* susp'
      AND e.disease NOT GLOB '* susp.'
    GROUP BY e.ID
    HAVING MAX(e.disease = 'RA') = 1
       AND MAX(e.disease = 'SJS') = 1
       AND MAX(e.disease NOT IN ('RA', 'SJS')) = 0
),
patients_with_normal_platelets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.ID
    FROM main.Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.PLT > 100
      AND l.PLT < 400
)
SELECT COUNT(n.ID) AS patients_ever_normal,
       COUNT(*) - COUNT(n.ID) AS patients_never_normal
FROM overlap_patients AS p
LEFT JOIN patients_with_normal_platelets AS n ON n.ID = p.ID
LIMIT 1
